title: Косвенная речь: утверждения и сдвиг времён

why: Косвенная речь нужна, чтобы передать чужие слова: «Он сказал, что устал». В русском время в такой фразе не меняется («Он сказал: я устал» — «Он сказал, что устал»), а в английском время глагола обычно сдвигается на шаг назад: He said that he was tired.
formation: • Прямая речь: Tom said, "I am tired."
• Косвенная речь: Tom said (that) he was tired.
• Вводные глаголы: said (без дополнения) / told + кого-то (told me). He said he was tired. / He told me he was tired.
Present Simple → Past Simple: "I work" → he said he worked
Present Continuous → Past Continuous: "I am working" → he said he was working
Present Perfect → Past Perfect: "I have finished" → he said he had finished
Past Simple → Past Perfect: "I saw it" → he said he had seen it
will → would: "I will help" → he said he would help
can → could: "I can swim" → he said he could swim
• Меняются местоимения и слова времени/места: I → he / she, my → his / her, now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, here → there, this → that.
usage: 1. Пересказ чужих слов, когда вводный глагол в прошедшем времени.
She said she was busy. (Она сказала, что занята.)
2. Передача новостей и сообщений от коллег или клиентов.
The manager told us the meeting would start at ten. (Менеджер сказал нам, что встреча начнётся в десять.)
3. Если сказанное остаётся верным сейчас, сдвиг можно не делать.
He said that he lives in Paris. (Он сказал, что живёт в Париже. — и он там до сих пор.)
4. Если вводный глагол в настоящем (says, tells), время не сдвигается: He says he is tired.
signalWords: said (that), told me (that), explained, mentioned, added, now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before.
mistakes: ✗ He said me that he was busy. → ✓ He told me that he was busy. / He said that he was busy. (после said нет дополнения, после told оно обязательно)
✗ She said that she is tired. (в пересказе прошлого) → ✓ She said that she was tired. (сдвигаем время назад)
✗ He told that he was late. → ✓ He told me that he was late. (после told нужно «кому»)
✗ She said that she will come. → ✓ She said that she would come. (will → would)
✗ He said that he saw her yesterday. → ✓ He said that he had seen her the day before. (Past Simple → Past Perfect, yesterday → the day before)
remember: Said без «кому», told с «кому», а время делает шаг назад.

items.prompt: "I am tired," she said. -> She said that she ___ tired.
items.answer: was

items.prompt: "I work in a bank," he said. -> He said that he ___ in a bank.
items.answer: worked

items.prompt: "We will help you," they said. -> They said that they ___ help me.
items.answer: would

items.prompt: "I can drive," Tom said. -> Tom said that he ___ drive.
items.answer: could

items.prompt: "I have finished the report," she said. -> She said that she ___ finished the report.
items.answer: had

items.prompt: "I am reading a book," he said. -> He said that he ___ reading a book.
items.answer: was

items.prompt: "I visited Rome last year," Anna said. -> Anna said that she ___ visited Rome the year before.
items.answer: had

items.prompt: "We live in Kyiv," they said. -> They said that they ___ in Kyiv.
items.answer: lived

items.prompt: He (a) said me (b) told me that he was busy.
items.answer: (b) told me

items.prompt: She said that she (a) is (b) was hungry.
items.answer: (b) was

items.prompt: The boss (a) told (b) said that the meeting would start at ten.
items.answer: (b) said

items.prompt: He said that he (a) will (b) would call me later.
items.answer: (b) would

items.prompt: "I am leaving tomorrow." -> She said she was leaving (a) tomorrow (b) the next day.
items.answer: (b) the next day

items.prompt: "I saw him yesterday." -> She said she (a) had seen (b) saw him the day before.
items.answer: (a) had seen

items.prompt: They (a) told (b) said us that the train was late.
items.answer: (a) told

items.prompt: "I like this place." -> He said he liked (a) this (b) that place.
items.answer: (b) that

items.prompt: "I don't know the answer," she said.
items.answer: She said (that) she didn't know the answer.

items.prompt: "I will call you tomorrow," Mark said to me.
items.answer: Mark told me (that) he would call me the next day.

items.prompt: "We are working on a new project," they said.
items.answer: They said (that) they were working on a new project.

items.prompt: "I have lost my keys," he said.
items.answer: He said (that) he had lost his keys.

items.prompt: "I can't come to the party," Kate said.
items.answer: Kate said (that) she couldn't come to the party.

items.prompt: "I bought a new laptop yesterday," Ben said.
items.answer: Ben said (that) he had bought a new laptop the day before.

items.prompt: "My brother lives in Germany," she told me.
items.answer: She told me (that) her brother lived in Germany.

items.prompt: "I am going to learn Spanish," Olga said to us.
items.answer: Olga told us (that) she was going to learn Spanish.

items.prompt: She said me that she was tired.
items.answer: She told me that she was tired. / She said that she was tired.

items.prompt: He said that he is hungry. (He spoke an hour ago and is not hungry anymore.)
items.answer: He said that he was hungry.

items.prompt: They told that they would come.
items.answer: They told me that they would come. / They said that they would come.

items.prompt: She said that she will help me.
items.answer: She said that she would help me.

items.prompt: He told me that he saw her the day before.
items.answer: He told me that he had seen her the day before.

items.prompt: Tom said that he can speak French. (reported in the past)
items.answer: Tom said that he could speak French.

items.prompt: She said that she was going to call me tomorrow. (reported a day later)
items.answer: She said that she was going to call me the next day. / She said that she was going to call me today.

items.prompt: I told to him that I was busy.
items.answer: I told him that I was busy.

items.prompt: Он сказал, что устал.
items.answer: He said that he was tired. / He said he was tired.

items.prompt: Она сказала мне, что работает в банке.
items.answer: She told me that she worked in a bank. / She told me she worked in a bank.

items.prompt: Менеджер сказал, что встреча начнётся в десять.
items.answer: The manager said that the meeting would start at ten. / The manager said the meeting would start at ten.

items.prompt: Они сказали нам, что уже закончили проект.
items.answer: They told us that they had already finished the project. / They told us they had already finished the project.

items.prompt: Мой друг сказал, что не может прийти.
items.answer: My friend said that he couldn't come. / My friend said he couldn't come. / My friend said he could not come.

items.prompt: Она сказала, что вчера была в Лондоне.
items.answer: She said that she had been in London the day before. / She said she had been in London the day before.

items.prompt: Он сказал мне, что позвонит завтра.
items.answer: He told me that he would call the next day. / He told me he would call tomorrow.

items.prompt: Клиент сказал, что ему нравится наш дизайн.
items.answer: The client said that he liked our design. / The client said he liked our design. / The client said that she liked our design.
